name: manual-lending-walkthrough
description: Step-by-step walkthrough of the hands-on `lending` subcommand family. State is persisted to `$HOME/.princeps/lending-state.json` between commands, so you can inspect after each step, change parameters, and re-check. Useful for evaluating individual flows (deposit / borrow / health-check / scan) without committing to the all-in-one demo. Pair with `princeps lending list` between any two steps to see the full position state.
headline: Walk the lending sandbox by hand: deposit, borrow, check health, scan for underwater positions.

steps.explanation: Initialize an empty lending state file (idempotent — safe to re-run).
Account 1 borrows 200 ETH at the current oracle price of 1 USDC/ETH.
Check account 1's health at the same price — should be HEALTHY.
Now check health at an ETH price of 2 — the debt is worth more in USDC terms.
Scan all accounts for underwater positions at ETH=2.
